privacy_policy: Teaching IDs, conditions, token strings and opaque ordered snapshot digests only. No raw SQL rows/timestamps/runtime identity/secrets/progress.
clone_only_policy: Original models and all loaded answer/options/hint/pivot snapshots must match exactly; bounded UK prefixes only; unknown/partial decorations fall back all-or-nothing; no SQL in presenter.

review_summary.review: Agent editorial review plus independent selected-five review; not external human review.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: She looked confused by the question
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: She looked confused by the question

all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The question was confusing
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Natural source-of-difficulty contrast to confused; the short UK prefix clarifies meaning, not a supposed inanimate/-ed prohibition.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: We were amazed by the result
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: We were amazed by the result
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Grammatical and usable reserve. With only five places, experienced states are already represented by looked confused and felt disappointed; satisfied with adds a distinct complement. Amazing retains this lexical family on the source-of-impression side. This is not rejected as incorrect English.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: the result was amazing
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The result was amazing
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Natural second -ing property example without equating all -ing words with continuous tense.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: He felt disappointed after the delay
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: He felt disappointed after the delay
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Natural feeling through felt; retains an explicit past-time relation and avoids treating by as the sole possible adjoining preposition.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: the delay was disappointing
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The delay was disappointing
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: English key is grammatical, but original UK «Затримка була розчаровувальною» is less natural than the selected conditions. Disappointed is already covered and two -ing source examples remain. Do not rewrite the protected original or call the English key ungrammatical.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: They were satisfied with the service
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: They were satisfied with the service
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Natural named state with satisfied with and plural past agreement; meaning matches the UK condition.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: the service was satisfying
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The service was satisfying
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: The English sentence can be grammatical. Original UK «Сервіс був задовільним» normally evaluates adequacy (satisfactory), whereas satisfying emphasizes that it gives satisfaction. The overlap is not an absolute grammar ban, but this is not a sufficiently exact controlled translation for the selected five. Do not repair it by a long contextual condition.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: I was shocked by the accident
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: I was shocked by the accident
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Grammatical usable reserve, not a defective key. Another experienced state with by offers less structural variety than the chosen looked / felt / satisfied with sample within exactly five questions.

all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: the accident was shocking
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The accident was shocking
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: English key is grammatical. Another singular be + -ing property is not required after confusing and amazing; original UK «шокуючою» is also less natural than selected conditions. Protected wording remains untouched.

all_eligible_review.condition_uk: Вона відчула полегшення коли повернулася додому
all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: She felt relieved When She got home
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: She felt relieved When she got home
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Existing native helper preserves the internal uppercase When, so the actual output is not ordinary sentence casing. The repeated shared She option is correctly two ordered instances and must not be deduplicated. Exclude rather than changing a shared option, global helper or the protected original; do not invent context to excuse the capital.

all_eligible_review.condition_uk: Рішення було таким що принесло полегшення
all_eligible_review.actual_ordered_key: the solution was relieving
all_eligible_review.native_case_word_key: The solution was relieving
all_eligible_review.editorial_reason: Relieving is not universally impossible, but this bare solution was relieving formulation and the original UK «Рішення було таким що принесло полегшення» are less natural controlled A2 material than available alternatives. This is a bounded editorial quality choice, not an absolute grammatical prohibition. No ready answer is manufactured through a long condition.
